name: zhud_mgr_hide_tracked_progress_meter_if_owner_matches
description: HudUiMgr::HideTrackedProgressMeterIfOwnerMatches hides the selected-track progress meter when the tracked sensor slot owner matches the supplied payload.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD manager/source-cluster pass because the original codegen depends on the global HUD object layout and surrounding class/source context.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x412620 validates the fastcall owner payload in ECX, the null check on g_HudUiMgrSensorTrackedProgressSlot, the tracked slot track-node payload comparison at offset 4, and the selected progress meter virtual SetVisible(false) dispatch through vtable slot 0x60.
The native smoke verifies no dispatch for a non-matching owner, one SetVisible(0) dispatch to g_HudUiMgrSensorMeter for a matching owner, and no dispatch when the tracked progress slot is null.
